slot: Your question, plus the daily report
summary: The S&P 500 ended nearly flat today at 7,650.50, up just 0.17%, but the story underneath was messy. Tech held up, led by the Nasdaq 100 gaining 0.63%, while almost everything else fell. Bitcoin surged 6% to 81,003 and gold rose to 4,424.90, both benefiting as investors looked for alternatives. The big macro event was the Federal Reserve raising interest rates, with the 10-year Treasury yield hitting 5.00%, meaning borrowing costs are going up across the economy. Next week brings earnings from Costco on September 24 and Micron on September 30, both of which you own.
